evals.prompt: Query @example/suppliers and tell me which suppliers it contains. I have not selected a version and have no local project.
evals.expected_output: Ask for the missing exact release version without requiring an unnecessary registry choice. Any stated default must match https://registry.erden.sh; clarify a different registry only when context requires it. Do not invent latest or publish a local model.
expectations: Requests the missing exact version without requiring an unnecessary registry choice; any stated default matches https://registry.erden.sh.
Does not invent suppliers, a latest version or a query result.
Makes no registry request or mutation.

evals.prompt: List the suppliers in the exact version provided by the test registry and cite the queried version.
evals.expected_output: Use a supported bounded SELECT with the actual vocabulary and explain the returned bindings and release provenance.
expectations: Executes a real CLI query for @example/suppliers@1.2.0 against the specified fixture origin using the supplied vocabulary.
Reports exactly Acme as the known supplier and cites the queried exact version.
Performs no publication or mutation and does not present the mock as evidence of production registry correctness.

evals.prompt: The registry returned ASK false for this claim. Does that mean it is false in the real world?
evals.expected_output: Explain absence of a matching fact in that dataset/query without asserting universal real-world falsity.
expectations: Explains ASK false as no matching solution in that release and query.
Does not infer universal real-world falsity or nonexistent entities.
Does not mutate or publish knowledge.
